_about: Operations parameters for the clearance service layer (clearance/). Kept apart from config.json because config.json is being edited by another session. Every value here is PROPOSED: a placeholder until the owner decides it in DECISIONS.md.
_max_cost_credits_per_day_status: PROPOSED (D50): credits per calendar day (machine local time) across all runs in one database; a call is refused once the day's ledger total reaches it
_breaker_status: PROPOSED (D51): consecutive transient failures (timeout, connection error, 5xx, malformed or empty body) on one endpoint before the service stops calling it for the rest of this run attempt
_retention_status: PROPOSED (D52): days a raw person-level response or unredacted person-call params may stay in the database; 0 = purge at the first purge after the run

request_limits._status: PROPOSED (D53): 200 matches the model-field limit in nl.py; 253 is the DNS maximum for a domain name; 100 for a person name is a placeholder

_size_bands_status: PROPOSED (D54): headcount bands for the fairness report
